description:
Dünya üzerinde Ay veya Mars ile benzer özellikler taşıyan bölgelerden ülkemizde yer alan Salda Gölü veya dünyadaki Haughton Krateri ve Ölüm Vadisi gibi, uzay görev ekiplerinin ekipmanlarını ve yöntemlerini uzay görevlerinden önce test etmelerine olanak tanımak için yerler tespit edeceğiz. 

Görevimiz için 5 farklı alan belirleyeceğiz ve  NASA ve diğer uzay ajanslarının verileriyle Yapay Zeka tarafından bilgilendirme aracı geliştireceğiz.
summary: TerraTwin is an open-source web atlas that uses NASA open data to find places on Earth that resemble the Moon base and Mars targets. It ranks 21 sites by mission type and shows the evidence level and source behind every match. In our pilot analysis we measured the terrain and climate of 26 areas with NASA data; on the Moon base terrain score, NASA’s known analogs beat the control areas (median 59.1 vs 42.1). It runs in the browser in English and Turkish, with no install or account: terratwin-xi.vercel.app
details:
TerraTwin

Finding the right test site on Earth before we go to the Moon and Mars An open atlas that shows mission teams, researchers and students which Earth site truly works for which experiment, with the evidence behind it.

We rehearse on Earth. But where?

Analog sites are poorly defined The challenge says it plainly: there are places that look like the Moon or Mars, but which one suits which experiment is unclear. Sites are often chosen by appearance Barren volcanic ground looks lunar, but the polar light, ice and ridge–crater geometry a base needs may not be there at all. Challenge: find Earth places that resemble the Moon base and Mars targets using measurable criteria, and show where they match and where they differ.

Four users, one question: “Will this site work for me?”

Mission and engineering teams Rank sites for a rover, landing or power test by mission type, and see in advance where each site departs from the target.

Students and educators Learn Moon and Mars science with real NASA data, in English or Turkish, and see the evidence level and source of every claim.

Researchers Compare new candidate sites with NASA’s known analogs on the same criteria; download the raw results and reproduce them.

Regional science communities See the place of sites like Lake Salda, Nemrut and Cappadocia in space research, backed by NASA sources
